items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:48:1
items.html:
The seven last ones etc. are in the form of Yods, except for the two first Nekudot. (55) For the Kamatz and Patach are the root of all the Nekudot, as the ARI writes further on, since the Kamatz is Keter and the Patach is Hochma. And you already know that the GAR of Nekudim is divided into Galgalta ve Einayim, which is called Keter, and AHP, which went outside this Keter and is called HB. This division comes about because of the two Heys that joined together and rose to the Einayim, on account of which the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Nekudim were divided by the secret of the bottom Hey in the Einayim and YHV [Yod-Hey-Vav] in AHP. That is, the screen of phase two of clothing, which is the secret of the first Hey, is called here by the name Vav, since it is male; and the last Hey, who joined with this Vav in the Nikvey Einayim, is the dot inside the Vav, for a dot indicates the quality of judgment, in the secret of a black dot that has no whiteness in it at all. However, the joining of the dot with the Vav in the Nikvey Einayim does not make a Shuruk there, but only a Kamatz, for the Vav is laid down and the dot is beneath it, which is the secret of a firmament and a spark. And the reason is that AHP is found to go outside because of this joining of the firmament and the spark; it is therefore called Kamatz, from the language of closing and sealing, which comes about through the ascent and the joining of the bottom Hey in the Einayim. For the YHV that now illuminate in AHP are in a state of closing and sealing, since they suffer from two things. One, that their whole level is phase one, since they are the female of Keter (as above, page 413, the passage beginning “Now the male”; study it there well), so that they must receive the illumination of GAR from the male, which is the Keter; yet because of the Kamatz in the vessel of Keter they are no longer reckoned as a Rosh, and they cannot be included in the male in Keter. And two, that they became a Guf; therefore this HB is found to be back to back.
However, in and of themselves they are YHV, as above in the words of the ARI, that YHV is in AHP. And there is a great matter in this, for he informs us here that the bottom Hey, which is the secret of the dot beneath the Patach in the Nikvey Einayim and which makes the Kamatz there, as above, did not descend from there to AHP. Rather, only the firmament — which is the secret of the line above the dot, resembling a Patach — descended alone to AHP, without taking with it even something of the dot, that is, of the bottom Hey. Hence the screen in the Peh is a Vav alone, without the dot that is included in it in the Nikvey Einayim.
Now it has been explained that the screen in the vessel of Keter of Nekudim includes within it a Patach and a dot, which is the secret of a firmament and a spark, that is, the form of a Kamatz; while the screen in the vessel of HB of Nekudim is only an expansion of the Patach that is included in the Kamatz in the Nikvey Einayim, that is, in the vessel of Keter, and it has nothing of the dot in it.
However, at the time of the coupling of AB SAG, which causes the bottom Hey to descend from the Nikvey Einayim to the place of the Peh as at first (as above, page 406, the passage beginning “And the second coupling”), it turns out that the Kamatz in the vessel of Keter descends and joins with the vessel of HB, where there had been only a Patach. And by this the opening of the Einayim comes about, for the place of the coupling that was in the Nikvey Einayim in the secret of the Kamatz, as above, which had been sealing off the lights — they were opened wide, since AHP returned to the Rosh, as above; study it there well. For then the light descended to the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim. And you see how all the rest of the Nekudot emerged from the coupling of Kamatz and Patach.
And it has been explained that after the descent of the Kamatz to the place of the Peh, that is, by means of the coupling of Gadlut, the seven lower Sefirot emerged. It thus turns out that these seven Nekudot emerged from the secret of the dot that is inside the Kamatz. For as long as this dot was included in the Nikvey Einayim, and there was in the Peh of Nekudim nothing but the Patach alone, the seven Nekudot could not expand from the Peh downward, since at that time AHP itself was a Guf and the Patach in the Peh was the Malchut of Malchut, which is called Tabur. But after the descent of the bottom Hey to the place of the Peh, the lights of the seven lower Sefirot were opened and came out to their place. Thus the whole merit of the ZAT is drawn from the dot, and for this reason they are intimated in the form of Yods, that is, dots alone, since they are drawn not from the secret of the firmament, which is a Patach, but from the secret of the spark, as explained.
And this is what he says, “All seven of the last of the Nekudot are in the form of Yods, except for the two first Nekudot, which are Kamatz and Patach, which are two Vavs and a Yod,” which is for the aforementioned reason. For the Vavs, which are the secret of the Patach, are included only in Keter and Hochma: a Vav and a dot in Keter, which is the form of a Kamatz, and a Vav alone in Hochma, which is the form of a Patach. But in the ZAT there is nothing there but the dot alone, for it is from there that they come out, as above.

items.html: From the eye the Nekudot came out: This is as above in the adjacent item, that through the descent of the bottom Hey from the Einayim all the Nekudot came out.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:48:3
items.html: The twenty-two letters, from which the vessels of the Nekudim were made: The vessels are called letters, and the number twenty-two includes all the discernments of vessels in reality, as is known. And it has already been explained how all the ZAT emerged from the coupling of Kamatz and Patach; and at that time new vessels also emerged for them, called the posterior vessels, as is written in its place.
